title: Front Desk Executive / Receptionist
description: Handle guest check-ins, check-outs, reservation inquiries, phone calls, and assist guests with a welcoming attitude.
requirements: Good communication skills in Hindi & English; Knowledge of hotel PMS software / computer operations; Customer-centric and professional hospitality attitude.

title: F&B Captain / Multi-Cuisine Chef
description: Prepare authentic Garhwali, North Indian, and Chinese dishes for resort guests, manage kitchen inventory, and maintain high hygiene standards.
requirements: Proven experience as Chef / Cook in hotel or resort; Knowledge of North Indian, Tandoor & Garhwali cuisines; Strict food safety and kitchen hygiene management.

title: Housekeeping Supervisor
description: Oversee guest room cleanliness, linen maintenance, daily housekeeping staff schedule, and public area sanitation.
requirements: Prior experience in hotel/resort housekeeping; Strong attention to detail and staff supervision skills.
